name: Hotel reputation alerts: bad TripAdvisor reviews → Slack + Sheets

parameters.content:
## Hotel reputation alerts: bad TripAdvisor reviews → Slack + Sheets
Every morning: read the newest TripAdvisor reviews of your hotels, keep only the ones rated 3 bubbles or less that say something, log them all to a sheet and post the ones you have not seen before to Slack.

**Setup**
1. Credentials → **Header Auth** named `Apify Header Auth`: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer <your Apify token>` (apify.com → Settings → API & Integrations). Select it in *Run TripAdvisor reviews*.
2. Put your hotels' TripAdvisor location ids (the `d<number>` in a hotel URL) in the JSON body of *Run TripAdvisor reviews* — or swap them for `startUrls` / `hotelNames`.
3. Connect Google Sheets and Slack. The sheet needs a header row: review_id, hotel_name, location_id, rating, title, text, review_date, stay_date, trip_type, reviewer_name, reviewer_hometown, response_status, url, is_new, fetched_on — the append matches on `review_id`, so a review that comes back tomorrow updates its row (a late management response lands in the same one) instead of duplicating.

Actor: https://apify.com/kestrel/tripadvisor-reviews-scraper — $0.005 per delivered review. `maxRating: 3` and `requireText` filter before billing, so the 4- and 5-bubble reviews cost nothing: worst case 2 hotels × 40 × $0.005 = $0.40 a day, in practice a few cents. Hotel and status rows are free.
